msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia le-coquett-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing a khaki green parka with a fluffy brown faux fur lining, black tights and a brown leather handbag from the reference, walking at a sunny shopping street in the centre of Barcelona, Spain, with modernist buildings and trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia le-coquett-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a red and burgundy patterned knit jumper with red corduroy trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia le-coquett-09.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a navy and mustard zigzag knit jumper with blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.

IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia le-coquett-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle fashion photo: a model wearing a reversible quilted shirt jacket in khaki green and navy blue, two looks side by side from the reference, candid and relaxed in a sunny street of Barcelona, Spain, natural light, framed from the knees up, editorial, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia le-coquett-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a warm fashion boutique with mannequins in quilted jackets and knitwear, wooden shelves with autumn decoration and a light floor, no people, no text, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
